_comment: "Once per Turn Action - 0: Attack / If you've charged this turn, Raydn gains +3{p}." THE ACTIVATION COST IS AUTHORED HERE, unlike every other weapon in this batch, and it is the whole reason the card was unplayable: engine/card.py parses an activation cost by counting {r} symbols and only accepts a count > 0, so a printed cost of '0' leaves activation_cost None -- and play._add_weapon_attacks requires `activation_cost is not None` before it will offer a weapon attack at all. Raydn could never attack. `activation_cost` is read TOP-LEVEL by the loader (loader.compile_card reads raw['activation_cost']), not from an ability, so it belongs here rather than inside the WHILE_STATIC; a declaration nested in an ability is silently unread. Charge is recorded as a turn event by the canonical keyword function (effect_keywords records 'charge' with the charged card's slug/types/classes/talents), so EVENT_THIS_TURN reads it without new engine state. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK scopes the +3 to this weapon's own attacks -- the weapon is equipped all game and an ungated pump would apply to everything its controller attacks with. Corpus: 6140 attacks, previously all skipped as unimplemented.
